name: AsteroidOS Sync
blurb: AsteroidOSSync is the official Android companion app for synchronizing your AsteroidOS smartwatch.
description:
AsteroidOSSync is the official Android companion app for synchronizing your AsteroidOS smartwatch.

• Time sync
• Weather sync
• Notification sync
• "Find my watch"
• Grab a screenshot

To learn more about AsteroidOS, visit https://asteroidos.org/
